## What are you trying to do

Describe the problem, not the feature. What are you building, and where does
GoQuorra get in the way?

## What you want

## Have you read the milestones

[docs/milestones.md](../../docs/milestones.md) holds what is not built, and
what was looked at and deliberately left. Several common requests are already
there with the reasoning behind the decision.

If your request is one of them, say what has changed. Each entry names what
would change the answer.

## What it would affect

- [ ] It changes the worker protocol, so a running worker would need replacing
- [ ] It changes the database schema
- [ ] It adds a dependency
- [ ] It changes what a job means, or what a status means
- [ ] None of these

## How you would know it works

What would you measure to say this is done and correct?
